{{Quote|A good clone knows how to recognize a great warrior, and this armor should help channel the strength of a Wookiee.|Wookiee clone trooper description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''Wookiee clone trooper''' were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Despite the name, they were not actually [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clones, but rather were named because their armor was patterned after the fur and equipment of the Wookiees.

The overall armor resembled that of the standard [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] utilized by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. The armor apparently also augmented the clone's strength to be comparable to that of a Wookiee. The overall set cost about 2,900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], with the specific costs being 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the gloves and boots; 900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the helmet; and 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the main armor.

==Behind the scenes==
The armor was not based on any particular character, and was an invention of SOE. In addition, it's the only special costume gear that was neither released during either a real-life holiday nor during a special in-game event, although it was suspected by some players to have been meant for the holiday [[Wikipedia:Father's Day|Father's Day]].
